text:
maria-sales: heads up  VertexLabs wants pilot pricing for reseller program. ask: $60k one-time migration credit + 20% discount on year 1 subscription. Net30. they also want a usage cap rollback if overage > 120% in month 1. can we approve?
evan-fin: need unit economics. what's expected ARR after pilot? link to their draft PO?
maria-sales: they committed to 9 customers for pilot, estimated run-rate $40k/mo post-migration. PO attached (pdf link): https://files.redwood/vertex/po-draft.pdf
sophie-dealdesk: propose exception template: a) onboarding credit capped at $60k applied to first invoice only, b) 20% off MRR for first 12 months, c) usage rollback clause limited to pilot scope, d) require signed reseller agreement and acceptance tests. Also add milestone clause: 3 paying customers by day 60.
pricing-bot: quick sensitivity: projected gross margin with discounts = 28%. Payback = 6.1 months. Note: if >25% overage calls occur, margin drops to 18%. See calc: https://redwood.internal/pricing/PP-9912
oliver-cfo: 28% is below target. I'm open if this becomes strategic reseller channel with carry-forward revenue. Sales: one-line justification pls. Also prefer Net15 for pilot to reduce credit exposure.
maria-sales: justification: access to 300+ EDU schools via Vertex resellers; low CAC channel, expected upsell in Q4. Net30 is their procurement standard.
lina-legal: will need reseller addendum + explicit clawback on credits if milestone not met within 90 days. I can draft limited-duration escrow for credit recoupment. Also need data residency SLA for EDU customers.
evan-fin: accounting guidance: treat credit as contra-revenue. For amortization, if milestones unmet, reverse credit and book as receivable. GL codes: SALES_CREDIT and CREDIT_RECOVERY. I'll send codes.
anna-ops: ops note: if they request capacity burst, we need reservation clause. recommend cap bursts to 150% of committed for first 90 days.
sophie-dealdesk: can we set final conditional approval: (1) reseller agreement signed, (2) Net30 + PO received, (3) 3-customer milestone by day 60 or clawback triggers. If legal + finance OK, I can file DD-9912.
oliver-cfo: conditional approved: require escrow clause + 60-day milestone (clawback pro-rated). Also cap total exposure to $60k only. If milestone fails, recover full credit.
maria-sales: acknowledging conditions. I'll get signed PO and push reseller LOI.
pricing-bot: Deal Desk ticket DD-9912 created: status -> awaiting docs. Assigned: sophie-dealdesk, lina-legal, evan-fin.
evan-fin: scheduling 15min review tomorrow 09:00 to finalize GL mapping.
lina-legal: draft addendum uploaded to ticket.
sophie-dealdesk: moving to "approved-conditional". Will update when PO + signed reseller agreement arrive. :white_check_mark:
